instruction: Write a short story about a cat.
response: Once upon a time there was a little cat named Whiskers. Whiskers loved to chase butterflies in the garden. One day Whiskers caught a beautiful blue butterfly and gently let it go.
The sun is a big bright star in the sky. It gives us light and warmth every day. Without the sun plants could not grow and we would be very cold.
Dogs are friendly animals that love people. They like to play fetch and go for walks. Dogs are loyal companions and they always greet you with a wagging tail.
A forest is a place with many tall trees. Animals like birds and squirrels live in the trees. The forest floor is covered with leaves and moss and tiny flowers.
In spring the weather gets warmer and the snow melts away. Flowers start to bloom and trees grow new green leaves. Birds come back from the south and start building their nests.
The ocean is very big and very deep. It is full of fish and whales and dolphins. The waves crash on the shore and leave shells and seaweed on the sand.
The moon is a round white ball in the night sky. It does not make its own light but reflects the light from the sun. Sometimes the moon looks like a full circle and sometimes like a thin slice.
On a rainy day water falls from the clouds. Puddles form on the ground and the streets get wet. Some people stay inside but others put on boots and raincoats and splash in the puddles.
Birds fly through the sky using their wings. They build nests in trees where they lay eggs. In the morning birds sing beautiful songs to greet the new day.
A garden is a special place where flowers and vegetables grow. You need to water the plants and give them sunshine. Bees and butterflies visit the garden to drink nectar from the flowers.
